systems.system: SIGE (systeme d'information de gestion de l'education)
systems.platform: computer platform with seven modules including state examinations, transfers and staff
systems.owner: Ministry of pre-primary, primary, secondary education and literacy; run by DSIC, maintained by Agence congolaise des systemes d'information

note: The 2023 decree creates an EMIS with a unique learner number inside one platform; it states no link to another system, ID or sector.
